description.zh: 定时任务的配置信息，列表结构。
description.en: An array of scheduled task configurations.

description.zh: 是否允许终端用户自行配置定时任务。
description.en: Whether to allow end users to configure the scheduled task.

description.zh:
定时任务Cron表达式。

><notice>需要传入UTC标准时间，即北京时间每天0点应该传入0 0 16 ? * 1,2,3,4,5,6,7></notice>
description.en:
The cron expression for the scheduled task.

><notice>

The cron expression is based on UTC. For example, to run a task at 00:00 China Standard Time (UTC+8) every day, set this parameter to `0 0 16 ? * 1,2,3,4,5,6,7`.

></notice>
Whether to forcefully execute the scheduled task.

description.zh: 定时任务操作类型，目前仅断连定时任务支持。
description.en: The operation to perform for the scheduled task. This parameter is valid only when `TimerType` is set to `NoConnect`.

description.zh: 无操作定时任务智能判断的进程白名单，如果指定的进程正在运行则不支持无操作定时任务。
description.en: The process whitelist for smart detection. If a process from this whitelist is running, the inactivity-based scheduled task does not run.
The reset type for the cloud desktop.
The type of the scheduled task.

description.zh: 无操作定时任务触发配置类型。
description.en: The trigger condition for inactivity-based scheduled tasks.
The description of the configuration group.
The name of the configuration group.

description.zh: 配置组使用的产品类型。
description.en: The product to which the configuration group applies.

description.zh: 地域ID。该功能无地域属性，该字段固定填写`cn-shanghai`。
description.en: The region ID. This feature is not region-specific. You must set this parameter to cn-shanghai.
The type of the configuration group.
